name: Aeronautics & Astro (PMn)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
A Ph.D. minor in Aeronautics and Astronautics may be obtained by completing 20 units of graded, graduate-level courses in the Aero/Astro Department, following a program (and performance) approved by the department’s Director of Graduate Studies. Seminars and independent study (research) units do not count toward the required 20 units. A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 on these courses is required to fulfill the Ph.D. minor. The student’s Ph.D. Reading Committee and University Oral Committee must each include at least one faculty member from Aero/Astro.
A student who wishes to obtain a Ph.D. minor in Aero/Astro should consult with the Aero/Astro Student Services Office for the designation of a minor advisor.

rules.name: 20 units of graded graduate-level Aero/Astro courses
GPA of 3.0 on the minor courses
Program approved by the Director of Graduate Studies
An Aero/Astro faculty member on your reading committee and on your oral committee

transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit counts 20 letter-graded units of Aero/Astro courses numbered 200 and above, leaving out seminars, research and thesis units. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA on those courses, the Director of Graduate Studies' approval of your program, and that your reading and oral committees each include an Aero/Astro faculty member.
